prompt: Exactly six elegant fabric ribbons laid in a single horizontal row on a warm wooden table, evenly spaced, each ribbon vertical with soft curls and folds catching warm light. Top-down editorial photography, warm natural lighting, soft shadows, fine fabric texture, photorealistic, magazine quality.
